cards.name: RuPay Platinum
cards.welcome_benefit: 300 reward points on first usage (within 90 days of activation)
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge access via RuPay Platinum benefit programme (per-quarter caps set by NPCI programme, not by PNB)
cards.notes: Bank markets card as 'no joining and annual fee if card is used once in a quarter'. PNB devalued reward points from Rs.0.50 to Rs.0.25 per point effective 1 Sep 2024; some aggregators still show older Rs.500 fee/values. Cashback offers on utility bills and dining are promotional, not a fixed rate.

cards.name: RuPay Select
cards.welcome_benefit: 300 reward points on first usage; 2X reward points on retail spends in first 90 days
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic lounge access plus 4 complimentary international lounge visits per year via RuPay Select benefit programme
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.500-Rs.3,000, capped at Rs.250 per billing cycle
cards.notes: Earn rate 2 points per Rs.150 (~1.33/100). Annual fee waived with at least one retail transaction every quarter (not a spend threshold, hence fee_waiver_spend null). Points valid 3 years from accrual. Point value Rs.0.25 after Sep 2024 devaluation.

cards.name: RuPay Millennial
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international airport lounge visits (counts not published by PNB)
cards.eligibility: Age 21-65; minimum gross annual income Rs.5 lakh; credit limit Rs.50,000-Rs.10 lakh (or up to 80% of FDR, min FDR Rs.65,000)
cards.notes: Youth-focused card. Earn rate 2 points per Rs.150 per aggregators (official page does not state it). Extras: comprehensive insurance up to Rs.10 lakh, premium health check-up package, complimentary golf, spa sessions and gym membership - exact counts/partners not published.

cards.name: Visa Classic
cards.notes: Basic all-purpose card; nil joining and annual fee per PNB Schedule of Fees & Charges. Up to 2 add-on cards.

cards.name: Visa Gold
cards.notes: Annual fee waived per SoFC if preceding-year usage exceeds the card's credit limit, with at least one retail transaction (non-fuel, non-cash) every calendar quarter and the account never irregular - conditional waiver, not a fixed spend threshold.

cards.name: Visa Platinum
cards.notes: Earns 2 points per Rs.150 on retail spends (vs 2 per Rs.200 on lower PNB Visa cards per official page wording). Annual fee waived if card used at least once each quarter in preceding year. 24/7 global concierge desk.

cards.name: Visa Signature
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic lounge access (counts not published)
cards.eligibility: Age 21-65; minimum gross annual income Rs.7.5 lakh; credit limit Rs.1.25-15 lakh (or up to 80% of FDR)
cards.notes: PNB's premium Visa for HNI segment. BookMyShow offer: 50% off movie tickets (monthly cap). 24x7 concierge. Add-on card Rs.500 one-time. Earn rate 2 points per Rs.150 per aggregators; official page does not state it.

cards.name: Wave & Pay
cards.notes: PNB's contactless (tap-to-pay) card on the Visa Platinum platform; earns 2 points per Rs.150 per BankBazaar (official page gives no earn rate or fees - fees per aggregator). Contactless PIN-free limit Rs.5,000/txn, Rs.6,000/day.

cards.name: Rakshak RuPay Platinum
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge access via RuPay Platinum benefit programme
cards.eligibility: For defence and armed-forces personnel holding PNB Rakshak salary accounts (official page does not restate eligibility)
cards.notes: No joining fee; annual fee nil if card used once each quarter. Terms otherwise mirror the regular RuPay Platinum.

cards.name: Rakshak RuPay Select
cards.welcome_benefit: 300 reward points on first usage; 2X reward points on retail spends in first 90 days
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge access via RuPay Select benefit programme
cards.eligibility: For defence and armed-forces personnel holding PNB Rakshak salary accounts
cards.notes: No joining fee (waived vs Rs.500 on regular Select); annual fee waived if card used once each quarter. Otherwise mirrors regular RuPay Select including insurance and lounge programme.

cards.name: Patanjali RuPay Platinum

merchant_bonuses.merchant: Patanjali stores (2% cashback, txn > Rs.2500, max Rs.50/txn)

cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge access via RuPay Platinum benefit programme
cards.notes: Co-brand with Patanjali Ayurved. No joining/annual fee if used once a quarter. Patanjali bonus is direct 2% cashback (only on transactions above Rs.2,500 at Patanjali stores, ceiling Rs.50 per transaction) - modelled here as 8 points/Rs.100 at Rs.0.25/point equivalence; the per-transaction cap cannot be expressed in this schema. Patanjali Ayurved separately offers 5-7% cashback on Swadeshi Samridhi card recharges paid with this card.

cards.name: Patanjali RuPay Select

merchant_bonuses.merchant: Patanjali stores (2% cashback, txn > Rs.2500, max Rs.50/txn)

cards.welcome_benefit: 300 reward points on first usage; 2X reward points on retail spends in first 90 days
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge access via RuPay Select benefit programme
cards.notes: Annual fee (Rs.750 per aggregators) waived if card used once each quarter. Patanjali 2% cashback only on transactions above Rs.2,500, max Rs.50/txn - modelled as 8 points/Rs.100 equivalence; per-txn cap not expressible in schema. Plus 5-7% cashback from Patanjali Ayurved on Swadeshi Samridhi recharges.

cards.name: BLISS
cards.milestone_benefits: Quarterly brand vouchers (Nykaa, Uber/Ola, BookMyShow); annual Swiggy One, Gaana Plus and OTT memberships; annual spa session and health check-up; quarterly 20% Netmeds discount (min order Rs.999)
cards.lounge_access: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year (1 per quarter) + 1 complimentary international visit per year
cards.eligibility: Gross annual income Rs.3.6 lakh and above
cards.notes: Lifestyle-benefits card on the RuPay Platinum platform; UPI-enabled. 1 reward point per Rs.100 on retail categories. PNB warns bundled vouchers/memberships may be revised over time.

cards.name: Salary RuPay Platinum
cards.milestone_benefits: Quarterly Myntra voucher Rs.250 and Ola/Uber voucher Rs.100; annual spa service, health check-up, OTT membership (Zee5/SonyLiv); quarterly 20% Netmeds discount (min Rs.999)
cards.lounge_access: 4 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year (1 per quarter) + 1 international per year
cards.eligibility: PNB salary account holders under EXCEL scheme; minimum gross monthly income above Rs.25,000
cards.notes: Fees not published on the product page (expected nil/waived as a salary-account benefit - unverified, hence null). UPI-enabled. Personal accident/disability insurance up to Rs.2 lakh.

cards.name: Salary RuPay Select
cards.milestone_benefits: Quarterly vouchers: Myntra Rs.250, Ola/Uber Rs.100, Bigbasket/Blinkit Rs.250; annual spa, health check-up, Swiggy One (3 months), Gaana Plus and OTT memberships; quarterly 20% Netmeds discount (min Rs.999)
cards.lounge_access: 8 complimentary domestic lounge visits per year (2 per quarter) + 2 complimentary international per year
cards.eligibility: PNB salary account holders under OPTIMA & IMPERIAL schemes; minimum gross monthly income above Rs.75,000
cards.notes: Fees not published on the product page (expected nil/waived as a salary-account benefit - unverified, hence null). Earns 2 points per Rs.150. Personal accident insurance up to Rs.2 lakh. 24/7 multilingual concierge.

cards.name: LUXURA RuPay Metal
cards.welcome_benefit: 20,000 reward points on spending Rs.50,000 within 90 days of activation (official page; CardInsider lists 40,000 - discrepancy unresolved). Joining fee waived on Rs.2.5 lakh spend within first 3 billing cycles.
cards.milestone_benefits: Milestone rewards worth up to Rs.6,500 on spend thresholds (thresholds not itemised on official page); ITC hotels 2+1 nights offer, HoteLux membership, 4 complimentary golf rounds per year
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited complimentary domestic and international lounge access
cards.eligibility: Age 21-70; salaried gross monthly income Rs.1.5 lakh+ or self-employed annual income Rs.18 lakh+; credit limit Rs.1-50 lakh
cards.notes: PNB's flagship metal card (launched 2025). 4 points/Rs.100 base with 3X (12 points/Rs.100) on travel and dining. Zero forex markup. Air-accident insurance up to Rs.1 crore. Point value Rs.0.25 (4 points = Re.1 per PNB's own wording on the Visa LUXURA page).

cards.name: LUXURA Visa Metal
cards.welcome_benefit: 20,000 reward points on spending Rs.50,000 within 90 days of activation. Joining fee waived on Rs.1.5 lakh spend within first 3 billing cycles.
cards.milestone_benefits: Buy-1-get-1 movie tickets (up to Rs.200/month); Visa Luxury Hotel Collection, ITC Hotels and Agoda offers; Visa concierge
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited complimentary domestic and international lounge access
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: Fuel surcharge waiver up to Rs.350 per billing cycle
cards.eligibility: Age 21-70; salaried gross monthly income Rs.1.5 lakh+ or self-employed annual income Rs.18 lakh+; credit limit Rs.1-50 lakh
cards.notes: Official page states '4 reward points (worth Rs.1) for every Rs.100 spent' - i.e. Rs.0.25/point, 1% base value; 3X on travel and dining. Zero forex markup.

cards.name: EMT RuPay Platinum (EaseMyTrip)
cards.welcome_benefit: EaseMyTrip vouchers worth Rs.3,000 (split across flights, hotels, holidays) plus 300 reward points on activation
cards.milestone_benefits: Ongoing EaseMyTrip discounts: 10% off domestic flights (max Rs.1,000), 10% off international flights (max Rs.5,000), 20% off domestic hotels (max Rs.5,000), 20% off international hotels (max Rs.10,000), Rs.125 off bus bookings (min Rs.500); all capped at 4 transactions per month
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge access via RuPay Platinum benefit programme
cards.eligibility: Credit limit Rs.50,000-Rs.5 lakh per bank's risk model
cards.notes: Travel co-brand with EaseMyTrip. Earn rate 4 points/Rs.100 per CardInsider (official page states no earn rate - treat as unverified). Accident death/disability insurance up to Rs.2 lakh.

cards.name: Kiwi RuPay (virtual)
cards.milestone_benefits: Optional paid Kiwi Neon membership (~Rs.999/yr + GST) raises UPI cashback to 2%, adds milestone cashback up to 5% and lounge access
cards.lounge_access: None on free tier; lounge access only via paid Kiwi Neon membership
cards.eligibility: Issued digitally via Kiwi app; standard credit assessment
cards.notes: Launched April 2026 with Kiwi (UPI credit-on-RuPay app). Marketed as lifetime free, but some users report the PNB portal showing a Rs.750 annual fee waivable on Rs.1.5 lakh annual spend - fee status unresolved at launch. Cashback modelled per README convention (1 unit = Re.1): 1.5% on UPI scan-and-pay, 0.5% on online spends (base). Terms from Kiwi/aggregator sources; no PNB product page yet.
